{{Top|leg}}
'''Hover vanes''' were propulsion units used on [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[Methane Sifter Ramjet]]s. They were powered by gases like [[Methane/Legends|methane]] and [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]] being burned in a compressed [[ignition chamber]]. Hover vanes allowed the vehicle to be efficient and virtually noiseless.
